hero.title: A *new chapter*, on the other side of the world.
hero.lede: I’m moving to Queenstown, New Zealand, to join the staff of YWAM. Here you can follow along, read my letters and see what God is doing, one step at a time.

globe.label: An interactive globe with the route from the Netherlands to Queenstown, New Zealand. Drag it, or use the arrow keys, to turn it.

story.title: Why I’m going to the *other side* of the world.
story.lede: I’m Ruben. In {departure} I fly to Queenstown, New Zealand, to serve full time with Youth With A Mission (YWAM). My faith grew step by step, and my DTS there changed the most: I learned so much about God, the Bible and who I am. Here’s the short version of what comes next.
story.vision: I’m going to Queenstown to disciple young people in everyday life and to serve YWAM bases with IT and software, so that young people discover who they are in God and bases can run well and safely.

chapters.title: The place
chapters.body: I know YWAM Queenstown from my DTS, and it’s a beautiful place. This isn’t a choice I pulled out of my pocket: it’s a calling I received after weeks of prayer and seeking, and God confirmed it through the people who prayed with me.

chapters.title: The people
chapters.body: It hurts me how many people my age believe lies about who they are and about God’s love. Many of the young people live on the base, so discipleship doesn’t stop at five o’clock: it happens over games in the evening, at dinner and on the ordinary days.

chapters.title: The plan
chapters.body: I’ll look after the base’s IT and build software that YWAM bases can use, so bases with little IT know-how can still run well and safely. Next to that I do what all staff do: the café, the kitchen, cleaning, the sound for worship nights and joining in with evangelism.

chapters.title: The team
chapters.body: YWAM staff don’t get a salary, so I’m building a team that sends me: in prayer, with a monthly gift and by following along. I leave friends, family and Ignite, the youth group I pour my heart into, so the people back home matter a lot.

journey.title: The road from here to *Queenstown*.
journey.lede: Moving to the other side of the world doesn’t happen in one go. These are the stretches of the road, and where I am on it right now.
journey.suitcase: A packed suitcase with a sprig of green under its strap

stops.title: Getting ready
stops.body: My NZeTA is applied for and my job is handed in. Now: building the team that sends me, sorting what I sell, store or take, and saying goodbye well.

stops.title: Departure
stops.body: From Schiphol to Queenstown, more than 18,000 km, with one checked bag, one backpack and a lot of people praying along.

stops.title: On staff
stops.body: Living and working on the base: IT and software, the everyday staff jobs and life with the young people. There, with YWAM’s help, I switch to a longer visa.

letters.title: Letters from *the road*.
letters.lede: Once a month I write a letter home: what I’m doing, what God is doing, and what to pray for. Read the latest one here.
letters.art: A small stack of airmail envelopes tied with string, with a sprig of green tucked under it

card.title: The first letter is on its way
body: I’m writing the first letter right now. It goes out before I fly in {departure}: how the preparations are going, what saying goodbye is like and what I could use prayer for.
After that a letter comes once a month, from Queenstown. Sign up and it comes straight to you.

involved.lede: I can’t do this on my own, and I don’t want to. These are four ways to be part of it, from wherever you are.

give.body: Transfer to the account below: monthly with a standing order, or once. Every amount helps, small or large.
